title: SCoPE2 Protocol for Mass Spectrometry Analysis
author: Harrison Specht
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bwb3paqn
materials: Deposit into an MS glass insert.

steps.title: Prepare 384-well Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a 384-well thermalcycler plate (ThermoFisher AB1384) for single cell sorting.

substeps.instruction: Add 1uL of 25 fmol/uL Waters MassPrep (dissolved in HPLC-grade water) to each well.
Seal the plate with adhesive foil (Thermo Fisher Scientific; cat. no: AB0626).

steps.title: Sort Single Cells
steps.instruction: Isolate single cells into the prepared plates using a cell sorter (e.g., CellenONE, BD FACSaria, Sony MA900, or MoFlo Astrios).

substeps.instruction: Ensure cell sorter lines contain only PBS and no proteinaceous mixtures (e.g., FBS or Serum Albumin).
Wash cells in suspension 3x with ice-cold PBS prior to sorting.
Sort single cells into the prepared plates.
Spin down the plate and immediately freeze at -80 C.

steps.title: Prepare Carrier and Reference Channels
steps.instruction: Prepare isobaric carrier and reference channels from sorted cells or cell culture, ensuring they are as close in composition to the single cells as possible.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells in ice cold PBS or saline at least 3x to remove proteinaceous cell culture media.
Dilute cells to 2000 cells / ul in mass spec grade water.
Freeze for 20 min at -80 C.
Heat for 10 min at 90 C in a thermal cycler or similar device.
Allow to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Digest Carrier and Reference Material
steps.instruction: Perform protein digestion on the carrier and reference material.

substeps.instruction: Add triethylammonium bicarbonate pH 8.5 (TEAB) to a final concentration of 100 mM.
Add benzonase to a final concentration of 0.2x activity units.
Add trypsin to a final concentration of 10ng/ul.
Digest overnight at 37 C with shaking.

steps.title: Verify Digestion Efficiency
steps.instruction: Check the miscleavage rate of the digest using mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Take 1 ul of the digest and analyze by MS.
Search raw file with MaxQuant and analyze with DO-MS (refer to 'Carrier' tab).
If miscleavage rate is < 20%, proceed. If not, re-add the same amount of trypsin and re-digest overnight.

steps.title: Label Carrier and Reference Channels
steps.instruction: Label the carrier and reference materials with TMT tags.

substeps.instruction: Separate 1/40th (5/200th) of the sample to serve as the reference channel.
Dilute TMT tags to 1:4 of the manufacturer recommended concentration in acetonitrile.
Label carrier material with TMT126 and reference material with TMT127N, adding tags so final concentration is 30-40% v/v.
Incubate at RT with shaking for 1 hour.

steps.title: Verify TMT Labeling Efficiency
steps.instruction: Check the TMT labeling efficiency using mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Take 1ul of each carrier and reference and analyze by MS.
Search raw file with MaxQuant and analyze with DO-MS (refer to 'Carrier' tab).
If labeling efficiency is > 95%, proceed. If not, re-do the TMT labeling step.

steps.title: Quench TMT Labeling
steps.instruction: Quench the labeling reaction and combine channels.

substeps.instruction: Add hydroxylamine to a final concentration of 0.1% v/v.
Incubate at RT with shaking for 45 minutes.
Combine carrier and reference together and dry down in SpeedVac.

steps.title: Process Single Cell Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the frozen single cell plate for digestion.

substeps.instruction: Preheat a thermal cycler to 90 C with the lid at 105 C.
Quickly transfer the plate from -80C to the preheated thermal cycler for 10 minutes.
Spin down plate at RT.
Sonicate in a water bath for 5 minutes.
Spin down on a benchtop centrifuge to collect liquid.

steps.title: Digest Single Cells
steps.instruction: Perform on-plate digestion of single cells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a solution on ice of Trypsin Gold (TG), benzonase, and TEAB pH 8.5 such that in the final digestion volume: TG is 10ng/ul, TEAB is 100 mM, and benzonase is 0.2x concentration.
Add 0.2uL of 20 ng/uL TG in 200 mM TEAB pH8.5 and 0.4x benzonase to each reaction well.
Cover, vortex for 10s, sonicate for 10s, and spin to collect liquid.
Digest in thermal cycler for 3-18 hours at 37 C (lid 55 C).
Spin to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Label Single Cells
steps.instruction: Apply TMT labels to the digested single cells.

substeps.instruction: Remove TMT labels from -80C and allow to reach room temperature.
Dilute 85mM TMT labels 1:4 in acetonitrile.
Add 0.5uL of the resulting solution to wells.
Cover, vortex for 10s, sonicate for 10s, and spin down.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (22 C).
Add 0.2 ul of 1% hydroxylamine, cover, mix, and spin down for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Pool Samples and Finalize
steps.instruction: Combine single cell samples with the carrier/reference mix for MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the combined carrier and reference channel mix to a concentration of 200 + 5 cells / 5 ul.

Collect volume from each single cell well by adding 5ul of the carrier + reference mixture to the first well in each set, then serially passing that mixture through the remaining single cell wells in that set.
Pass 5 uL of 50% acetonitrile through each well in a given set and add to the combined sample.
Verify combined sample contains 5ul carrier+reference mixture, 5ul 50% acetonitrile, and approximately 12 x 2 ul single cell material (for TMT16) or 8 x 2 ul (for TMT11).
Evaporate sample in SpeedVac to an appropriate volume (e.g., 1.2 uL for a 1 uL injection).
Place the insert in a labeled MS vial, securely cap with a pierceable cap, vortex, and spin down.
Submit to QE (refer to https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-021-02267-5 for method and gradient).
